family_method: Full function AST shape, call targets, attribute names, comparison operators and control structure retained; local names and literal values normalized. Family membership routes review but does not assign properties. In the six Kimi K3 distributed tests, the check-dispatch string changes the target property and is split explicitly.

file_reviews.review: Reviewed representative function and relevant common helper; each member retains its assertion source or common helper oracle and unique literal conditions. Mappings are local property checks, not full end-to-end proof.
